# Bundled dependencies

These fixed versions are bundled so the application works offline and does not require npm install.

- **Three.js 0.180.0**, MIT, https://github.com/mrdoob/three — build modules, OrbitControls, RoundedBoxGeometry, RoomEnvironment, and BufferGeometryUtils. Original files from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/ . License: `three/LICENSE`.
- **cubejs 1.3.2**, MIT, https://github.com/ldez/cubejs — cubie model and Kociemba two-phase solver. Original files from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/cubejs@1.3.2/ . License: `cubejs/LICENSE`.

The two minimal package.json files specify the module format for local development and tests. Library source files are unchanged.
